attribute.title: 家庭人口规模分层
attribute.name: householdSizeBand
attribute.expression: case when householdSize = 1 then 'SINGLE_PERSON' when householdSize = 2 then 'TWO_PERSON' when householdSize = 3 then 'THREE_PERSON' when householdSize >= 4 then 'FOUR_PLUS_PERSON' else 'UNKNOWN' end

attribute.title: 主申请人年龄分层
attribute.name: applicantAgeGroup
attribute.expression: case when age(applicant.birthDate) < 30 then 'UNDER_30' when age(applicant.birthDate) < 45 then 'AGE_30_44' when age(applicant.birthDate) < 60 then 'AGE_45_59' when age(applicant.birthDate) >= 60 then 'AGE_60_PLUS' else 'UNKNOWN' end

attribute.title: 年龄分层
attribute.name: ageGroup
attribute.expression: case when age(birthDate) < 30 then 'UNDER_30' when age(birthDate) < 45 then 'AGE_30_44' when age(birthDate) < 60 then 'AGE_45_59' when age(birthDate) >= 60 then 'AGE_60_PLUS' else 'UNKNOWN' end

attribute.title: 考勤准时性
attribute.name: attendanceTimeliness
attribute.expression: case when attendanceStatus = 'EXEMPTED' then 'EXEMPTED' when attendanceStatus = 'MISSED' then 'MISSED' when attendanceStatus = 'PENDING' then 'PENDING' when checkIn is not null and checkIn <= deadline then 'ON_TIME' when checkIn is not null and checkIn > deadline then 'LATE' else 'UNKNOWN' end
